# Sandra Kim — Chief Operating Officer

- **Relationship:** Ray's direct report and closest operating partner. The plant managers report
  up through her. Joined Brandt in 2022 from an automotive-tier-one supplier.
- **Cadence:** weekly 1:1, Mondays 09:30; daily production call at 07:15.
- **Owns:** the [Operational Excellence / OEE program](../projects/operational-excellence.md) and
  overall network productivity; the operational side of
  [Slate](../projects/slate.md) (cleared).
- **Distinguishing fact:** brought the Lean/OEE discipline to Brandt; the 85% OEE target is hers.

## How to work with her
- Fluent in Lean; wants problems framed as constraints, not blame.
- Will give Ray the unvarnished floor reality — he relies on her to reconcile dashboards.

## Sensitivities
- Stretched: covering the vacant Greenville plant-manager seat personally until it's backfilled.
